evals.title: End of EDA returns to triage
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Scaffolded workspace with raw data and tabular library recorded.
- No `data/eda.md` yet.]

Explore the dataset and tell me what you found.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills cells run` for `data/eda.py`. - After findings, give a short summary and ask triage (deeper EDA vs next stage). It must NOT: - Design a learner or write `src/<pkg>/pipeline.py`. - Load `iterate-ml-experiment` or skip to `build-ml-pipeline`.
expectations: After findings, give a short summary and ask triage (deeper EDA vs next stage).
The response does NOT: Design a learner or write `src/<pkg>/pipeline.py`.

evals.title: Missing data is a status fact
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Scaffolded workspace with no data files and no data path.]

Run EDA.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Name `python -m skore_skills status`. - Explain that data is missing and ask triage. It must NOT: - Invent a dataset. - Start `build-ml-pipeline`.
expectations: Explain that data is missing and ask triage.
The response does NOT: Invent a dataset.
